key_findings: Diabetes abrogates CaV3.2 function in sciatic axons but induces functional CaV3.2 in cutaneous peptidergic endings, raising stimulated CGRP release reversible by TTA-P2.
CaV3.2 KO mice lacked the diabetes-induced increase in spontaneous C-fiber firing.
